verifications.claim: Submitting the empty account settings form shows visible validation feedback to the user.
verifications.evidence: Step 1 clicked “Save changes” with every field empty, and the subsequent observation in step 2 says the screen appeared unchanged with the fields still empty and showing placeholders; no visible validation message or other feedback was observed.

verifications.claim: Text inputs have persistent visible labels that remain available after a value is entered.
verifications.evidence: Step 3 observed that after entering “Taylor Morgan,” the “Full name” placeholder disappeared, and step 4 explicitly observed that Full name and Email address had no persistent visible label after values were entered.

verifications.claim: Saving valid profile details provides observable in-progress feedback (such as a changed or disabled button) and then a visible save confirmation.
verifications.evidence: Step 4 clicked “Save changes” after valid name and email were filled, but the only recorded observation describes the entered email and lack of labels; it records no button state change, disablement, progress feedback, wait duration, or concrete visible confirmation.

findingTexts: Submitting the account settings form with every field empty produces no visible validation feedback: no error message, error styling, or other on-screen indication is shown to a sighted user.
Full name, email, and company rely only on disappearing placeholders; populated name/email have no persistent visible labels.
results.intentUsed: This is an account settings form. Work through these checks and record exactly what you observe: 1. Press 'Save changes' with every field empty and describe what visibly happens on screen — any validation message must be VISIBLE to a sighted user, not merely present in the DOM. 2. Describe how each text input is labelled: state whether a persistent visible label exists, or only placeholder text that disappears once you type. 3. Fill in a valid name and email, press Save, and describe what the interface shows between the click and the confirmation — state whether the button changes, disables, or gives any progress feedback, and roughly how long the wait is.
